info.name: Veterinary Backend - Complete API Collection
info.description: Complete API collection for Veterinary Backend with all routes organized by modules

request.description: Register a new pet owner. Pet owners are auto-approved.
Register a new veterinarian. Veterinarians require admin approval (status: PENDING).
Login with email and password. Returns JWT token and refresh token.
Change password for authenticated user. Requires JWT token.
Get new access token using refresh token.
Request password reset code. Code will be sent to email.
Verify password reset code.
Reset password with verified code.
Approve a pending veterinarian. Admin only.
Reject a pending veterinarian. Admin only.
Create a new pet profile. Requires PET_OWNER role. Species: DOG, CAT, BIRD, RABBIT, REPTILE, FISH, HAMSTER, GUINEA_PIG, FERRET, HORSE, OTHER. Gender: MALE, FEMALE, NEUTERED, SPAYED, UNKNOWN.
Get pet details by ID. Only pet owner can access their pets.

query.description: Filter by active status (optional, default: true)

request.description: List all pets for authenticated pet owner. Supports filtering by species and active status.
Update pet information. All fields are optional.
Soft delete a pet (sets isActive to false). Medical records are preserved.
Get pet owner dashboard with statistics, upcoming appointments, recent activity. Requires PET_OWNER role.
Get veterinarian dashboard with statistics, upcoming appointments, recent activity. Requires VETERINARIAN role.
Get veterinarian's own profile.
Update veterinarian profile.
Get public veterinarian profile. No authentication required.
List all approved veterinarians. Public endpoint. Supports filtering.
Create a new appointment for a pet. Requires PET_OWNER role. bookingType: VISIT or ONLINE.
Get appointment details. Pet owners see their appointments, veterinarians see their appointments.
List appointments. Auto-filtered by role (pet owner sees their appointments, veterinarian sees their appointments).
Accept a pending appointment. Veterinarian only.
Reject a pending appointment. Veterinarian only.
Cancel an appointment. Pet owner only.
Mark appointment as completed. Veterinarian only.
Create a medical record for a pet. recordType: VACCINATION, SURGERY, LAB_REPORT, XRAY, PRESCRIPTION, WEIGHT, GENERAL, OTHER.
Get medical records for a pet. Filter by petId (required) and optionally by recordType.
Delete a medical record. Pet owner only.
Create a vaccination record. Veterinarian or pet owner can create.
Get vaccination records for a pet.
Get upcoming vaccinations (due within next 30 days).
Create a weight record for a pet. Unit: kg or lbs.
Get weight history for a pet.
List all active products. Public endpoint. Supports filtering by petType and category.
Get product details. Public endpoint.
Create a new product. Requires VETERINARIAN or PET_STORE role with active subscription.
Update product. Only product owner can update.
Delete product (soft delete). Only product owner can delete.
Create a new order. Requires PET_OWNER role.
Get order details. Pet owners see their orders, pet store owners see their orders.
List orders. Auto-filtered by role.
Update order status. Pet store owner only. Status: PENDING, CONFIRMED, PROCESSING, SHIPPED, DELIVERED, CANCELLED, REFUNDED.
Create a review for a veterinarian. Rating: 1-5. reviewType: OVERALL or APPOINTMENT.
Get reviews for a veterinarian. Public endpoint.
Get all conversations for authenticated user.
Get messages for a conversation.
Send a message in a conversation.
Create a video session for an appointment. Requires Stream.io configuration.
Get video call token for an appointment.
Get notifications for authenticated user.
Mark a notification as read.
Get admin dashboard with platform statistics. Admin only.
List all users. Admin only.
Upload profile image. Max size: 10MB. Allowed types: jpeg, jpg, png, gif.
Upload pet image.
Upload medical record file (PDF, image, etc.).
List all veterinary specializations. Public endpoint.
Create a new specialization. Admin only.
List all active subscription plans. Public endpoint.
Purchase a subscription plan. Veterinarian only.
Get current subscription for authenticated veterinarian.
List all active pet stores. Public endpoint.
Create a new pet store. Veterinarian or PET_STORE role.
Check if the API server is running. No authentication required.
